attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ce.callee_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.call_edges ce WHERE ce.caller_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py::create_graph' AND ce.passes_as_callback AND NOT ce.calls_directly ORDER BY symbol_id

request:
When the text-to-SQL LangGraph is assembled by create_graph in auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py, which functions or methods of this repository does create_graph hand over by reference, i.e. pass the function object itself as an argument to another call (as with graph.add_conditional_edges(node, router_fn, ...)) rather than calling it? Count only plain names passed directly as call arguments; functions that create_graph calls itself, values that are the result of a call (such as _make_soft_check_router(...)), lambdas, and local variables holding nodes do not count. Functions passed only inside an if/else branch of create_graph count. Return each distinct function's symbol ID.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: Finds the create_graph symbol in text_to_sql_graph.py and selects the internal symbols it passes by reference as call arguments (callback references) without also calling them directly. Each distinct callee symbol ID is returned.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ce.callee_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.call_edges ce WHERE ce.caller_symbol_id = 'auto_ontology/retrieval/text_to_sql/text_to_sql_graph.py::create_graph' AND ce.passes_as_callback AND NOT ce.calls_directly ORDER BY symbol_id
